Name: Aries' Wedding Dresses
Author: Ariesii
Description:
Ever thought that the lovely bachelorettes of Stardew Valley's wedding dresses were a bit plain? Well wonder no longer because Aries' Wedding Dresses is here to replace those bland dresses with some new personalised dresses and hair!

[size=4]Features[/size]
[size=3]- A new personal dress for each of the bachelorettes[/size]
[size=3]- Styled hair for each of the bachelorettes[/size]

[size=4]How to Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/size]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract into your Stardew Valley mods folder[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game and marry your chosen bachelorette, the new dress and hair will show up in the wedding cutscene![/size]
[/list][size=3]
This is my first ever mod so if there are any issues or you have a suggestion please feel free to let me know! I plan on working on more stuff in the future and this was basically a test run for me :)[/size]

Downloads.Description:
- Contains only one bachelorette, download this OR the main file not both!
- To change bachelorettes change
"Target": "Characters/Abigail",
"FromFile": "Characters/Abigail.png"
to a different bachelorette like Haley.

- Removed UpdateKey (it was being stupid)
- Fixed Abigail's hair slightly

Download this version or the One bachelorette version, not both!
